aldrich: Aldrich, and I never see any girl any better to work right than our Lena, and now she got to stand it all the time with that old woman Mrs.
Aldrich her good mistress spoke to her kindly, and then Lena would seem to go back and feel herself to be like she was when she had been in service.
Aldrich, they are much better when they only know it, to stay in a good place when they got it, and keep on regular with their working.
Aldrich, but he is just the way always his mother wants him, he ain't got no spirit in him, and so I don't really see no help for that poor Lena.
Aldrich, but poor Lena, it would be better for her if her Herman had stayed there in New York that time he went away to leave her.
Aldrich how old people can be so bad to young girls and not have no kind of patience with them.
